description: Maiden batting rating model v1. Latent = shrunk weighted mean of blended (tournament+era) percentile features; higher percentile = better. See docs/rating-methodology.md.

shrinkage.note: latent_shrunk = w*latent + (1-w)*50, w = innings/(innings+k). Pulls small samples toward the population median percentile.

excluded_features.bat_boundary_rate: highly correlated with strike rate; excluded from v1 to avoid double counting
excluded_features.bat_highest/bat_fifties/bat_hundreds: milestone counts correlated with runs/average; not in v1 latent
